column2: Meet Wisp: an AI companion that lives beside your cursor on your Mac. It sees what you point at, talks with you, and gets things done, privately, on your Mac.
Hold Option and Command, and just ask. Wisp looks at the window you're in, answers out loud, and points right at what you need.
While you hold the keys, your pointer becomes a pen. Circle anything, and Wisp knows exactly what you mean.
Answers start in about half a second, because Wisp reads your screen while you're still talking. Prefer typing? It's the same assistant, with your whole conversation.
Say "Agent" to hand off a task. Reminders, calendar, notes, music and files. Wisp does it in the background, and tells you when it's done. Anything that changes something asks first.
Connect services like Notion or GitHub through MCP. You decide which tools Wisp may use, and which it should never touch.
Hold Control and Shift to dictate into any app. Your words appear where your cursor is, in under half a second.
Tap twice for a hands-free conversation. Wisp listens, answers, and listens again, and never while it's speaking.
Run everything locally with open models, or bring your own OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini key. Choose the voice you like.
Local Only is the default: nothing leaves your Mac unless you say so. Wisp. A companion for your Mac.
